Offers like 3% or 0% making charges on gold jewellery look very attractive, but do they actually save you money? In this video, Shubham breaks down the complete economics behind gold making charges, wastage allowances, and jewellery billing. Learn how gold travels from mines to showrooms, how artisans are actually paid, and how some jewellers offset low or zero making charges through higher gold rates or hidden wastage fees. Discover the key questions you must ask about purity, net weight, and the final GST-inclusive bill before making your next gold purchase.
